remarks: One bedroom cottage tucked away in the heart of Darien! Quiet location that's easily walkable to shopping & restaurants, Metro-North train station, Farmer's Market, Cherry Lawn, and Tilly Pond. Open floor plan offers tons of natural light. Living room has vaulted beamed ceilings and a contemporary kitchen outfitted with stainless steel appliances. Bedroom has a spacious walk-in closet with washer / dryer. Tenant pays one months rent, two months security, and utilities: heat (propane), electric, cable / internet, and security system. No smoking, no parties. Pet restrictions; Fee may apply. Inquire for details. Owner reserves the right to meet applicant. Agent related to Owner.
